classification: Three bounded helper/exclusion chains, NOT three independently credited creatures.
identity_limit: Fixed local cache pin and content hashes only; no independent remote tree verification; old1.12 source not Forge1.20.1 drop-in API.

corpse.initial_state: Separate0.6x0.2 entity, random fixed yaw; no living body pose/matrix transfer and no death producer found in available cached Java callers. Fixed authored corpse model renders intact hierarchy, not individually released body parts.
corpse.motion: onUpdate subtracts gravity.08 unless disabled, moveSELF only Y. Supplied X/Z velocities are ignored by that call. canBeCollidedWith true, but inherited1.12 collision consumer not read here: cannot claim mutual piling. No explicit angular integration, contact latch, surface alignment or packed rest layout.
corpse.fade: Player interaction randomly attempts loot; only after loot exhaustion sets fading and sends status80. Server/client then increment fadeTimer. Renderer alpha=1-min(1,(fadeTimer-1+partial)/40), source-over blend, real model draw; server removes after timer>50. Hence rendering may be invisible for final~10ticks; not death-clock-triggered.
corpse.persistence: NBT saves fading,timer,looted,loot contents,rotation. Additional spawn data sends rotation/fading/timer; status80 triggers existing client. This is a directly read late-observer consumer, not only a named synced field. No runtime transport guarantee.
corpse.scope: No item loot/interaction/sound behavior to migrate to cosmetic armor. Renderer registration738 read. Alpha color reset after render not explicit here; no runtime GL-state proof.

mask_exclusion: SpiritTreeFaceMask extends EntityHanging; serializes type/hanging position/facing and broken drops mask item. Renderer draws separately baked mask model. Selected whole large-face onDeath254-324 changes world/location state and removes small faces, does not create flying mask pieces. No evidence for body debris or landing pile; armor mask object mesh not authored/copied.
volatile_soul_exclusion: Wight selected205-290 creates souls only while possessing a target during volatile phase; initial point is randomized normalized direction around parent and shoot has positive random Y. Whole soul entity homes after10ticks, noClip, target damage/deflection, dies on owner absence/nonvolatile or strikes. Initial upward launch does not establish rising death flame. Renderer is camera-facing face quad plus4-position interpolated billboard trail, not volumetric flame mesh; trail intensity decrease is spatial, no whole-soul age fade. No new projectile mechanics copied.
wight_render_boundary: Whole renderer uses actual head-only model for volatile state, constant.4 alpha, growth/hiding scaling and two passes. Model implementation not read here. This is active phase transformation, not released corpse flame rise/fade.
remaining: Original body component release, complete transform handoff, gravity/contact/rest/pile, independent ghostflame birth/rise/fade and44tick cleanup remain unimplemented/unaccepted. Helpers and rejected branches do not add1000 credit.
